# 2026-10-17 JST：ラベル作成・4フレーム教師・学習と精度確認（label-learning-local-v1-20261017）

- ローカル専用 /label-learning と /api/label-learning、画像配信API、ラベル別の独立分類モデルを追加。管理入口へリンク。ラベル作成/改名/休止、動画4枚確認、該当/非該当/未確認、手動正解保存、10件以上から学習、教材内グループ分割検証と未使用動画の盲検チェック。
- 新状態は .local-admin/label-learning-v1 のみ。Tierのモデル/教師/設定、既存 data/labels、DB、Cron、新着予約/取得位置、手動除去、掲載判定を変更しない。動画候補は既存DBの限定カラムを読取のみ。X/FxTwitter再収集なし。
- 10/25/50/80%の4画像と既存の画像特徴抽出を再利用、Tier重みと分類ヘッドは独立。画像/特徴を保持し一時動画を削除。96MiB/動画上限、1本ずつ処理、10本ボタンの停止は現在の動画終了後。保存済みの同投稿と動画本体hash重複を拒否。FFmpeg/FFprobeと既存画像モデルが必要。
- 未確認を負例にしない。ラベルごと該当/非該当2件以上、全体で10教材以上から試作。判定スコアは校正済み確率/正解率ではない。同じ投稿者ID/同じ動画hashを教材の分割評価でグループ化。独立評価では過去に学習した動画/投稿者と予測を見てから保存/変更した正解を除外。10件で精度を保証せず、対象数/採点できた項目数/的中率/検出率/F1を表示。
- localhost/127.0.0.1/::1かつ非productionに限定、POSTは同一Origin必須、cross-site拒否、JSON上限32KiB、状態の原子的保存/排他/画面revision/破損拒否。GETはキャッシュ済みローカル状態のみ、DB/動画/画像モデルを取得しない。画像と教師/重みを公開Gitへ含めない。
- 現行実ローカルの対象/依存SHAを基準にコードのみ隔離コピー。型/Nextビルド成功。新機能模擬テスト成功。旧ローカルテスト3本のモック/Windowsパス不整合を確認し、2026-10-16 GitHub保存済みの修正済みテストを検証コピーへ使用したところ全37回帰成功。これら3本は本配布の変更対象ではない。FFmpeg依存2テストはPATHでツールが見つからず未実行。実DB/CDN/学習精度/実ブラウザーは未確認。
- インストーラーは未知の対象/依存版を拒否し、変更対象のみバックアップ。再適用は同一版を保持、復元時は導入後の変更を検査してからコードを復元し、新しいラベル教師/画像/モデルを削除しない。ZIPの実配布ファイルによる検証結果は別添VERIFY-FINAL.json。
- 作成/隔離検証/配布候補。実ローカル・本番未適用。本番全source統合/動画詳細・タグ公開URLの実装とは別作業。10/14登録1,000/ランキングv2完了、10/15学習通信削減local完了と効果未測定、Fx24/8巡回、手動削除、保存機能の完了報告を維持。既存通知を追加/変更しない。

readOnlyRegistrationAudit20261014.finding: Current registration uses statuses by default, tagged legacy cursors retained. Empty continuation page with a bottom cursor is intentionally rejected; no advancement is persisted on that failure.
readOnlyRegistrationAudit20261014.scope: Local source plus known historical releases and three matching local registration records; no fresh production deployment inspection
readOnlyRegistrationAudit20261014.reproduced: Actual registration function with mocked dependencies: empty page + next cursor returns502 without advancing; empty initial page rejected; cursorless end completes correctly
readOnlyRegistrationAudit20261014.rootProviderCause: Not determined; raw provider response not stored, no live provider request made
readOnlyRegistrationAudit20261014.registrationDefaultFeed: statuses, with_replies disabled by the existing default; older cursor feed retained
readOnlyRegistrationAudit20261014.scheduledPatrolDifference: Fx scheduled new-post patrol uses its own logic; recent timeline/reply fixes do not remove registration empty-page guard

registrationRecoveryDesign20261014.directCause: Fx returns code200/results=[] with bottom cursor; registration rejects this before saving the next cursor. Every resume repeats the same request. Two sampled rows also repeat the provider cursor, so blind cursor advancement cannot resolve all cases.
registrationRecoveryDesign20261014.upstreamCauseLimitation: Exact underlying X/Fx reason for each empty page is unknown; empty or repeated cursors do not prove that all older posts were exhausted. Public upstream code builds result rows and cursor independently and filters unavailable rows.

proposedSolution.emptyAdvancingCursor: After a verified own-post page and confirmed prior publication/sync, accept a well-formed empty page only as a pagination gap. Persist feed-tagged next cursor and visited tokens without raising scanned/fetched/saved. At most3 consecutive empty transitions per bounded continuation; retain existing total page/request bounds and5-second spacing.
proposedSolution.repeatedOrCyclicCursor: Stop historical traversal rather than hammering the same token. Preserve the last cursor and all prior progress. Record history as partial/blocked, never falsely label all100 posts retrieved or historical exhaustion proven.
proposedSolution.separateReadiness: Separate initial setup/new-post patrol readiness from requested historical backfill completion. After server-side confirmation of a valid own-post baseline and successful initial-page processing, a blocked historical run can close as partial and allow ordinary new-post patrol. Do not skip initial guards for every author.
proposedSolution.synchronization: Local roster sync and authenticated production handlers must share the new optional readiness/outcome fields. Server acknowledgement is required before the local UI shows巡回可能. An old client must not silently clear confirmed readiness; a server lacking the capability must fail closed.
proposedSolution.resumeAndDoubleCollection: Retain backfill checkpoint separately for explicit historical resume. Initial/history fetch must hold an authenticated production activity lease or equivalent shared exclusion before enabling overlapping scheduled work; preserve server operation locks and DB duplicate protections. Exact lease design requires implementation review.
proposedSolution.baselineSafety: Keep the original confirmed own-post baseline. Do not jump to current time/latest fresh page or reset existing X/Fx watermarks and24-hour reservations. Missing/future/foreign baselines, auth/DB failure, pause/removal, unknown or malformed responses must not authorize patrol.
proposedSolution.unchangedPolicies: Fx provider; requested100/200/300 upper bounds;3-hour batches of8; rolling24-hour max24authors; same author24hours;5-second request spacing; failed-author quota; availability monitor; review/removal visibility policies.
proposedSolution.recoveryOfThreeAuthors: Upgrade both production and local handlers first, then resume each existing record. Walk only advancing gaps; close stalled historical traversal as partial when server-confirmed readiness permits. No unregister/re-add, count inflation or forced immediate patrol.
